answer: A new agent enters like a comet, burning capital to appear, and any delta between claimed and verified work triggers slashing of the bond. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent locks a bonded deposit to register, and voting power scales with that stake, so spinning up many identities costs proportionally more. Reputation is recorded on a crystal-clear ledger, making fake identities expensive to sustain and easy to detect. In practice, Agent0040 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
